name: skills_backend
scope: Common agent skills intended to be reused across Laravel/API projects.

consumer_policy.pinning: Projects should pin this repository by git tag or commit SHA before loading shared skills.
consumer_policy.project_specific_rules: Domain rules belong in the consuming project, not in this shared repository.
consumer_policy.upgrade_review: Shared skill upgrades should be reviewed against at least one real project before broad rollout.
